1.1.evidence:
I. GENERAL
Women and children have become a serious concern of the international community, considering their vulnerable position as victims of violence and discrimination from their families and environment. Various acts of violence against both women and children within the household as well as outside the household continue to increase from time to time. This condition, if without serious handling, will destroy the life of households, society, nation and state. Therefore, the Government of Magelang Regency is obligated to provide protection to women and children against acts of violence and discrimination which is an implementation of various laws and regulations, including Law Number 39 of 1999 concerning Human Rights, Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, Law Number 21 of 2007 concerning the Eradication of the Crime of Trafficking in Persons, Law Number 35 of 2014 Concerning Amendments to Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection.

Protection for women and children against acts of violence and discrimination is an obligation of the Regional Government in the context of regional autonomy, which is manifested in the form of Regional Regulations as stipulated in Article 236 paragraph (1), Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government.

On that basis, the Regional Government of Magelang Regency has taken steps as an effort to provide protection to women and children, including by issuing Regent Regulation Number 26 of 2010 Concerning The existence of these regulations is felt to be not yet capable of providing maximum and adequate protection against acts of violence and discrimination that occur in the social life of society. In addition to the problem of these laws and regulations, the factor of low public understanding of the rights of women and children has implications for the low legal awareness -17- of the community to report acts of violence or utilize the facilities provided by the Law to resolve their problems.

Based on these considerations, a regulation is needed in the form of a Regional Regulation concerning the Protection of Women and Children against acts of violence and discrimination that is able to answer while providing legal certainty in the protection of women and children against acts of violence and discrimination that occur.

This Regional Regulation is intended to provide responsibility to the Regional Government starting from the prevention of acts of violence to the handling of victims of acts of violence. This regional regulation also regulates the rights of victims of violence, Handling of Victims of violence, Government Responsibility up to the Participation of Government, Society and Family in the prevention and resolution of violence and discrimination against women and children.

In its implementation, the Regional Government is also allowed to establish cooperation with government agencies, other regional governments and the community. In addition, adequate funding arrangements sourced from the State Budget, Regional Budget, Village Budget as well as from the government, Regional Government or other Sources that are not binding are expected to guarantee the implementation of protection for women and children against victims of violence and discrimination.
1.1.rationale: The policy explicitly references domestic violence, including citing the law on the elimination of domestic violence and discussing violence occurring within the household.

1.2.rationale: The provided passages discuss violence and discrimination generally, but none explicitly mention sexual violence or clearly define/target sexual violence as a category.

Article 1

6. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
7. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and verbal that causes danger to life, body and/or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.
8. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.
9. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
10. Discrimination is any distinction, harassment or exclusion that is direct or indirect based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that results in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and basic freedoms in life both individual and collective in the fields of politics, economy, law, social, culture and other aspects of life.
11. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, forgery, fraud and -4- abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
12. Child is a person who has not reached 18 (eighteen) years of age including a child still in the womb. 13. Victim of violence is an individual or group of people who experience suffering either physical, mental or emotional, economic loss, or experience neglect, reduction or deprivation of their basic rights, as a result of human rights (HAM) violations, or criminal acts as well as acts of violence committed either by state apparatus or by the state or regional government apparatus or by individuals, including the victim's heirs.
14. Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children Victims of Violence and Discrimination, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an Integrated Service Unit established by the Regional Government to provide services and rehabilitation to women and children victims of violence comprehensively including information services, assistance and legal aid, counseling services, medical services and safe houses through referral.
15. Task Force for the Prevention and Handling of Criminal Acts of Trafficking in Persons, hereinafter referred to as the Task Force is a coordinative institution tasked with coordinating prevention and handling efforts of criminal acts of trafficking in persons in Magelang Regency.
16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction to be able to carry out their social functions normally.
17. Safe house (shelter) is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
18. Social reintegration is the process of preparing the community and victims that supports the reunification of victims into the work environment, substitute family that can provide protection and fulfillment of victims' needs.
19. Recovery of victims is all efforts to strengthen victims of violence against women and children to be more empowered, whether physical, psychological, social, economic or social.
-5-
20. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy and spiritual guidance, for the self-strengthening of women and children victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
21. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward to the third degree.
22. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or step father and/or mother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
23. Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
1.3.rationale: The policy defines violence as including acts against the physical (and verbal) that endanger life/body, and defines violence against women/children as resulting in physical suffering, thereby covering physical violence.

CHAPTER IX
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 20
(1) Regional Governments are obligated to conduct guidance on the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.
(2) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1), includes: a. guidelines and fulfillment standards;
b. technical guidance and training;
c. monitoring; and
d. evaluation.
(3) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) is conducted in order to realize the objectives of protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with minimum service standards implemented by Regional Apparatus that administer governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

CHAPTER VII
INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK
Article 14
(1) In the context of providing services to women and children victims of violence and discrimination as referred to in Article 7, the Regional Government shall establish an Institution with the name Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and -11- Children (P2TP2A) or similar institutions that have the same functions and roles as a service center in the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.
(2) P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), functions as: a. an information center for women and children;
b. a service center for women and children victims of violence; and
c. an empowerment center for women and children.
(3) P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be located in the Region and Sub-district.
(4) In the context of providing protection services for women and children from acts of violence at the village level, an Integrated Service Center shall be established.
